# DevTaskHub

> DevTaskHub is a full-stack web & mobile development studio based in Thessaloniki, Greece. It builds custom websites, e-shops, mobile apps (iOS & Android), AI chatbots and SEO solutions for businesses and professionals across Greece. Languages served: Greek, English, French.

## About
- Name: DevTaskHub
- Location: Thessaloniki (Θεσσαλονίκη), Central Macedonia, Greece
- Serves: All of Greece and the EU, remotely
- Email: devtaskhub@gmail.com
- Phone: +30 697 198 2563
- Positioning: Modern, fast, responsive, SEO-optimized digital products at fair prices. "You think the vision. We build it."

## Services
- [Website & Web App Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/web-development): Responsive, fast, SEO-optimized custom websites and web applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android, plus PWAs.
- [E-commerce Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ecommerce-development): Full-featured online stores (e-shops) with secure payments.
- [Chatbots & AI Agents](https://devtaskhub.com/services/chatbots-ai-agents): AI chatbots and agents for 24/7 customer support and automation.
- [AI Integration](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ai-integration-applications): Embedding AI and machine learning into applications.
- [SEO & Website Optimization](https://devtaskhub.com/services/seo-website-optimization): Technical SEO, performance and organic growth.
- [UX/UI Design](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ux-ui-design): User-centered interface design.
- [Database & Cloud Infrastructure](https://devtaskhub.com/services/database-cloud-infrastructure): Scalable, secure data and cloud architecture.
- [Video & Animation Production](https://devtaskhub.com/services/video-animation-production): Promotional video and motion graphics.
- [Game Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/game-development): Interactive games for web and mobile.

## Selected Work
- T-Parking: The first app in Greece that finds available on-street parking in real time, for free (iOS & Android).
- Advanced Derma: Appointment booking system for a dermatology & aesthetic clinic in Athens & Piraeus.
- Leonidion Houses: Booking platform for 6 accommodations with online payments and an admin system.
- Devil's Barber: Premium barber studio site with online booking.
- HANDSTUFF: E-shop for handmade leather bags.
